delivery.purpose: Git or Linear delivery after parent acceptance and applicable user authorization.
instructions: Activate only after gates; code corrections belong to the relevant implementation owner.
Use the existing shared lock across Dreamer, Lucid and Meditation; resolve its current owner and protocol before device work.
For Dreamer VNext use scheme noctalia and the base application only; never use a .qa package.
Distinguish a Play install from a local build and verify signature/version before any install. Never uninstall or clear app data to force an install.

constraints: Do not send private project content to free third-party inference endpoints; use an authorized supported model.
This device profile is for Dreamer VNext only. Resolve an app-specific profile and the shared lock protocol before Lucid or Meditation device work; never widen this allowlist implicitly.
Preserve all unrelated work and follow the active project instructions.
Do not infer delivery or production authorization from this profile.

The user's latest explicit task instructions take precedence over project and skill defaults, subject to system/developer instructions and actual tool permissions. Reuse existing authorization and delegated decisions.

The parent owns architecture and acceptance and may implement, integrate, document and run local checks; it does not operate a device. Substantial parent-authored changes require fresh independent review.

Grok/Astra/Muse are preferred assignments. If the live tool lacks a preferred model or effort, the parent may execute permitted work or disclose a capable supported fallback without another approval request. Preserve role permissions, appropriate effort and review independence. This user-approved policy overrides skill-level substitution bans; an exact model explicitly required for the current task remains mandatory.

Independent review is required for substantial implementation, but is not tied to Grok availability. Resolve the qa role to a capable supported reviewer when needed, distinct from authors. If none is available, continue independent authorized work and report acceptance as pending.
Do not create separate app tasks without an explicit user request or use external inference CLIs/APIs to bypass tool restrictions. Preserve the selected parent model and effort.
Skill questionnaires and approval checkpoints apply only to unresolved decisions the user has not delegated. Do not claim agent-selected drafts were personally reviewed or approved by the user.
Show cost receipts only when requested or supported by useful observed usage and applicable prices; missing telemetry never blocks progress or requires a placeholder receipt.
Keep worktrees persistent and file ownership exclusive. Request a checkpoint from slow agents instead of restarting.
Follow AGENTS.md for Uniwind, synchronized theme tokens, text-champagne-on and animation frequency gates. Tabs never slide.
Edit marketing sources in docs-src only; never edit or commit generated docs.
Use canonical package scripts. Expo prebuild, EAS builds, store submission, production deploys and destructive database actions require explicit authorization.
Report local, Motorola, Git, CI, deployment, Play and public HTTP evidence separately. Use INDÉTERMINÉ where evidence is missing.
